meta.titleEn: Trimebutine Maleate 200 mg Tablets (Gastrointestinal Motility Regulator)
meta.actionKo: 위장관 운동을 조절하여 소화기능 이상과 과민성대장증후군 증상을 개선하는 위장운동조절제입니다.
meta.actionEn: A gastrointestinal motility regulator that improves digestive function abnormalities and irritable bowel syndrome symptoms by regulating gut movement.

en.75fd1ca8: This medicine is used for digestive function abnormalities (abdominal pain, indigestion, nausea, vomiting) in esophageal reflux and hiatal hernia, gastritis and duodenitis, and gastric and duodenal ulcers; for irritable bowel syndrome and spastic colon; and for childhood conditions (habitual vomiting and non-infectious intestinal transit disorders (constipation, diarrhea)).
en.18714f6b: This medicine is used for digestive function abnormalities (abdominal pain, indigestion, nausea, vomiting) in esophageal reflux and hiatal (opening) hernia, gastritis and duodenitis, and gastric and duodenal ulcers; for irritable bowel syndrome and spastic colon; and for childhood conditions (habitual vomiting and non-infectious intestinal transit disorders (constipation, diarrhea)).
en.3802dfc4: This medicine is used for digestive function abnormalities (abdominal pain, indigestion, nausea, vomiting) in esophageal reflux and hiatal (opening) hernia, gastritis and duodenitis, and gastric and duodenal ulcers; for irritable bowel syndrome and spastic colon; and, as childhood conditions, for habitual vomiting and non-infectious intestinal transit disorders (constipation, diarrhea).
en.82a761dd: This medicine is used for digestive function abnormalities (abdominal pain, indigestion, nausea, vomiting) in esophageal reflux and hiatal hernia, gastritis and duodenitis, and gastric and duodenal ulcers; for irritable bowel syndrome and spastic colon; and for childhood conditions (habitual vomiting and non-infectious intestinal transit disorders such as constipation and diarrhea).
en.6d56a7ba: This medicine is used for digestive function abnormalities in esophageal reflux and hiatal (opening) hernia, gastritis and duodenitis, and gastric and duodenal ulcers, and for irritable bowel syndrome and spastic colon.
en.6e3b4051: This medicine is used for habitual vomiting in children and for non-infectious intestinal transit disorders (constipation, diarrhea).
en.e3820fa0: Adults take 0.5 to 1 tablet (100 to 200 mg) per dose, 3 times a day, before meals.
en.a620c3ef: Adults take 0.5 to 1 tablet (100 to 200 mg) per dose, 3 times a day, before meals. Adjust appropriately according to age and symptoms.
en.1dc76b29: Adults take 1/2 to 1 tablet (100 to 200 mg) per dose, 3 times a day, before meals.
en.563d4418: Adults take 1/2 to 1 tablet (100 to 200 mg) per dose, 3 times a day, before meals. Adjust appropriately according to age and symptoms.
en.7910027f: Adults take 100 to 200 mg per 1 dose, orally 3 times a day, before meals.

Before taking this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you are pregnant or may be pregnant, are breastfeeding, or are hypersensitive to Yellow No. 4 or have experienced hypersensitivity to it.
